description: Consolidated full-scale (300 train / 50 val) denat_amplitude deconfounding table. Held-out R2 for Linear and PLSR, CRN R2 mean+/-std across seeds. Built 2026-09-12 by merging results that were previously scattered across a JSON file, a log file, and one-off console output -- see 'source' per row for exact provenance. No PARAMS or model code changed to build this file; it is a consolidation of already-completed runs only.

source.method: deconfound_full_scale.py, run_one_amplitude() -- fresh 300/50 dataset generated under deconfound_outputs/data_amp_0.2/
source.file: deconfound_outputs/deconfound_results.json (verbatim, still the only entry in that file as of this consolidation)

amplitudes.crn_r2_note: Pooled R2. The SUPERSEDED_batch_averaged fields are the original values, computed before the 2026-09-13 metric fix, when R2 was averaged per mini-batch rather than pooled over the epoch. They are retained for traceability and must NOT be quoted.

source.method: Linear/PLSR: compute_amp04_baselines.py, run fresh against ligtas_synthetic_dataset/ (the frozen dataset, not a regenerated copy) -- re-run and reconfirmed identical (0.6212/0.6206) immediately before this file was written. CRN: NOT retrained here -- reused directly from crn_5seed_final/seed_0,1,2 (already trained on this same ligtas_synthetic_dataset/), per docs/TEAM_LOG.md's 2026-09-12 frozen-dataset entry.
source.file: compute_amp04_baselines.py output (Linear/PLSR); crn_5seed_final/seed_{0,1,2}/history.json (CRN, best-checkpoint val_r2 per seed)

notes: amp=0.2/0.6/0.8 used a freshly-generated 300/50 dataset per amplitude (deconfound_outputs/data_amp_{amp}/). amp=0.4 instead reused the pre-existing frozen ligtas_synthetic_dataset/ and its already-trained crn_5seed_final/ CRN run, to avoid redundant retraining of the live PARAMS value. All four use the identical held-out evaluation logic and the same PIXELS_PER_SAMPLE=400 pixel-sampling convention (sweep_denat_amplitude.sample_pixels()).

Linear/PLSR in-sample R2 is only available for amp=0.2 (from the JSON) and amp=0.4 (from the fresh script run) -- amp=0.6/0.8's in-sample figures were never saved anywhere retrievable (only held-out was printed to the summary line in deconfound_run.log), hence null above rather than a guessed value.
This file reports numbers only -- see docs/TEAM_LOG.md for any interpretation/conclusions, none of which are drawn here.
CORRECTION_2026_09_18: The crn_r2_mean/std fields in this file were originally written 2026-09-12, BEFORE the metric fix of 2026-09-13, and therefore held batch-averaged rather than pooled R2. They have been replaced with the corrected pooled values; the originals are kept under *_SUPERSEDED_batch_averaged. Linear and PLSR figures were always pooled and are unchanged. See docs/TEAM_LOG.md, entries of 2026-09-13.
